swap_risks: CAUTION BANDWIDTH & PHASE MARGIN: GBWP differs by 28.6x (OPA333AIDBVR: 0.35 MHz p.7 vs TLV9061IDBVR: 10 MHz p.13); higher-bandwidth replacements can oscillate with capacitive loads or stray feedback capacitance without an isolation resistor.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 40.6x (OPA333AIDBVR: 0.16 V/µs p.7 vs TLV9061IDBVR: 6.5 V/µs p.13); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).

CAUTION PRECISION OFFSET SHIFT: Maximum Vos differs by 160x (OPA333AIDBVR: 0.01 mV p.7 vs TLV9061IDBVR: 1.6 mV p.13); high-gain DC sensor stages may lose accuracy or require zero-drift chopper filtering.

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 140x (OPA333AIDBVR: 70 pA p.7 vs TLV9061IDBVR: 0.5 pA p.13); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 31.6x (OPA333AIDBVR: 17 µA/ch p.7 vs TLV9061IDBVR: 538 µA/ch p.14); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
engineering_verdict: OPA333AIDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TLV9061IDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because GBWP differs 28.6x; slew rate differs 40.6x; input offset voltage Vos differs 160x. Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 0.35 MHz (p.7) vs 10 MHz (p.13), supply ceiling 5.5 V (p.5) vs 5.5 V (p.10), Vos 0.01 mV (p.7) vs 1.6 mV (p.13), Ib 140x gap (70 vs 0.5 pA). Primary bench gotchas to watch: OPA333AIDBVR "Weak ±5 mA Output Drive and 350 kHz / 0.16 V/µs Speed Limit vs Pin-Identical TLV9001/TLV9061" (p.7) and TLV9061IDBVR "SOT-23-5 (DBV) Pinout Matches TLV9001/OPA333 DBV — Differs from SC70 (DCK) & U-Variants" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose OPA333AIDBVR when DC precision demands <= 0.01 mV max Vos or ultra-low supply current (17 µA/ch) is prioritized; choose TLV9061IDBVR when closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 10 MHz GBWP or high-impedance sensors require pA-class input bias (0.5 pA). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.5) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
